Frequently Asked Questions

What is FBR POS integration and why is it necessary?

FBR POS integration is the process of connecting your point of sale system with the Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) to ensure compliance with tax laws and regulations. It is necessary to avoid penalties and fines imposed by the FBR.

How does Phelix ERP ensure FBR compliance?

Phelix ERP ensures FBR compliance by providing a POS system that is integrated with the FBR, allowing for real-time reporting and compliance with SRO 1006 and SRO 673.

What are the benefits of using Phelix ERP for FBR POS integration?

The benefits of using Phelix ERP for FBR POS integration include avoiding penalties and fines, improving tax compliance, and increasing efficiency in tax reporting.

Is Phelix ERP certified by the FBR?

Yes, Phelix ERP is certified by the FBR and complies with all relevant tax laws and regulations, including SRO 1006 and SRO 673.

How much does Phelix ERP's FBR POS integration service cost?
